title: BCGOS Rich User Context
description: Rich onboarding context captured only when depth=complete. Feeds Maestro's advisory 3-option pattern: axis 1 (current project) reads current_project; axis 2 (broader BCG context) reads bcg_context.practice; axis 3 (OS evolution) reads os_evolution_intent.

description.description: One or two sentences: client, industry, nature of work.

stage.description: kickoff | diagnóstico | desenho de solução | execução | handover, or free-form.

friction.description: What would unblock the project today, in the user's words.

practice.description: Practice / tribe / discipline the user identifies with (e.g., AI@Scale, Insurance, Consumer).

os_evolution_intent.description: How the user wants Maestro to evolve: more advisory, more executive, focused on missing skills, etc.

captured_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the capture.
